mapper.select: /* isry.couns.offwork.OffworkMapper.selectLvffcPrcsBassInfo - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(y.FLNM_ENCPT) AS PIC ,SYSTIMESTAMP AS LVFFC_DT ,x.USER_ID AS CONSTT_ID FROM SAA200 x /* 사용자 */ ,SCA100 y /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1 AND x.ENFSN_NO = y.ENFSN_NO AND x.USER_ID = #{CONSTT_ID}
mapper.update: /* isry.couns.offwork.OffworkMapper.UpdateLvffcPrcs - 개발지원팀 이태호 */ MERGE INTO AYC495 a /* 상담원출퇴근관리 */ USING DUAL ON ( a.CONSTT_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} AND a.WORK_YMD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.LVFFC_DT = SYSDATE , a.LVFFC_IP_ADDR = #{LVFFC_IP_ADDR} , a.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , a.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE a.CONSTT_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} AND a.WORK_YMD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (INDEX_SN , CONSTT_ID , WORK_YMD , LVFFC_DT , LVFFC_IP_ADDR , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT) VALUES (AYC495_SQ01.NEXTVAL , #{CONSTT_ID} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , SYSDATE , #{LVFFC_IP_ADDR} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
